info.title: Budget Planner API
info.description: Static contract for the Budget Planner HTTP API. JSON amounts are numbers and transaction expenses are negative. Unless an operation is marked public, send the bp_session cookie returned by login or setup.

bpSession.name: bp_session
bpSession.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by /auth/login or /auth/setup.

SetupToken.name: X-Setup-Token
SetupToken.description: Required for non-local setup requests when SETUP_TOKEN is configured.

MetricsResponse.description: Prometheus text exposition; available only when METRICS_ENABLED=1.

BinaryResponse.description: Binary download. Content type is endpoint-specific (or application/octet-stream).

Json.description: Endpoint-specific JSON object or array. The API intentionally returns different shapes per resource.

file.description: CSV, XLS/XLSX, PDF, JPG, or PNG bank statement. PDFs use local text extraction/OCR; images use local Tesseract OCR.

AccountPatch.description: Any subset of editable account fields.

CategoryPatch.description: Any subset of editable category fields.

end_month.description: Inclusive end month; must not precede start_month.

IncomeSourcePatch.description: Any subset of income source fields. Empty dates clear the schedule limit.
